definitions.explanation: The number sixteen. Formed by combining {十|じゅう} (ten) and {六|ろく} (six).

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{十六|じゅうろく}{歳|さい}です。
{十六|じゅうろく}{日|にち}に{届|とど}きます。
examples.english: It will arrive on the sixteenth.

examples.japanese: {十六|じゅうろく}{個|こ}のりんごを{買|か}いました。
クラスに{十六|じゅうろく}{人|にん}の{学生|がくせい}がいます。
examples.english: There are sixteen students in the class.

examples.japanese: {十六|じゅうろく}{時|じ}から{十八|じゅうはち}{時|じ}まで{授業|じゅぎょう}があります。
examples.english: I have classes from 4 PM to 6 PM (16:00 to 18:00).

notes:
{十六|じゅうろく} is the number sixteen, following the standard Japanese pattern of {十|じゅう} (ten) + {六|ろく} (six).

COMMON USES:
- {十六|じゅうろく}{歳|さい}: 16 years old
- {十六|じゅうろく}{日|にち}: the 16th (of a month)
- {十六|じゅうろく}{時|じ}: 4 PM (16:00 in 24-hour time)

COUNTER VARIATIONS:
- {十六|じゅうろく}{人|にん}: 16 people
- {十六|じゅうろく}{個|こ}: 16 items
- {十六|じゅうろく}{回|かい}: 16 times

CULTURE:
In Japan, {十六|じゅうろく}{歳|さい} is not a particularly significant milestone like it can be in Western cultures. However, students enter high school around this age.
